reason_by_group.select-element-model: The expected tree shows <selectedcontent> filled with a clone of the selected <option>. That is not tree construction: it is the select element's DOM behaviour (option insertion, post-connection and children-parsed steps, the selectedness setting algorithm and 'update a select's descendant selectedcontent elements', HTML 4.10.7 and 4.10.10). It needs the DOM's element-behaviour hooks, the next stage. The harness fails if one of these starts passing, so the list can't go stale.
